[[Tommy (TV series)|Tommy]] - brother {{Icon|dead}} |dob = |location = |affiliation = |TV actor =[[Alexandra Albert]] }} '''Sandra''' is a character {{In|FOTV}}. ==''Fallout'' TV series== ===[[The Radio]]=== When [[Adam (TV series)|Adam]] and [[Tommy (TV series)|Tommy]] return home from scavenging, Adam calls out to Sandra that they are back. Unnerved, he calls out to his daughter again and sees the Ghoul eating a meal at their table, before Sandra appears and pours him a glass of water. The Ghoul thanks Sandra. He then implies that Adam thought he killed and ate his daughter, which he laughs off as Adam has Sandra wait outside.[[The Ghoul]]: ''"Thank you, darling. Oh, wait. You thought…? [laughs] Come on, now."''
({{FOTV|1|7}}) Shortly after, Sandra becomes Adam's last surviving child after Tommy is killed by the Ghoul. ==Appearances== Sandra appears only in the ''Fallout'' TV series. {{FOTV appearances|7=107}} ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox characters FOTV}} [[Category:Fallout TV series human characters]]
